tells.2: Brochure KPI cadence in 'finished last year with a 99.2% on-time rate,' then a clipped template ask.
tells.3: Corporate 'We provide' opener plus two stacked polite questions ending in 'where we might fit.'
tells.4: Back-to-back 'Would you be open to' questions, a repeated soft-ask pattern.

reason: Version 1 reads like someone in the business: concrete 'loads,' a plain on-time result, and one clear ask. The others flatten into brochure stats, stack polite questions, or add stock friendliness, and version 4 is too clumsy to sound skilled.
